name: sample-facet

protocol.note: vg-sample-facet samples a real MTLTexture through a real MTLSamplerState via a hand-written compute-encoder readback kernel (vg_sample_facet / vg_sample_facet_array). Coordinates are metal::SampleCoord {u,v,lod,array_slice}: Texture2DArray + mip are first-class inputs (06 §6.1), packed through CanonicalView::subresource_byte_offset (slice-major, then ascending mip). Compared against software-linear-sampler, a pure-CPU nearest/bilinear/trilinear oracle (reference::sample_facet) that reads the same backing bytes. A second run_sample_facet() call against the same FacetRef must report facet_cache_hit=true. An out-of-range slice or lod is rejected, not clamped. FastNative is the default uv-only overload (lod 0, slice 0); the SampleCoord overload takes an explicit ValidationProfile.

correctness.tolerance: nearest: exact texel match within 1/255 + 1e-4; bilinear: 1/255 + 1e-3 (float blend across GPU vs. CPU rounding)

judgement: vg-sample-facet demonstrates a real Metal MTLTexture/MTLSamplerState pair created from a CanonicalView -- including Texture2DArray and a mip chain -- sampled nearest (and bilinear/trilinear at a fractional lod) through a compute-encoder readback kernel, and matching the CPU software-linear-sampler oracle within float tolerance. Warm cache reuse is demonstrated directly via SampleFacetResult::facet_cache_hit. The Metal device advertises Capability::Raster, Capability::RepresentationTransform and Capability::CheckedFacetGeneration; raster itself is a separate pass (run_raster_triangles / E013 render PSO), not this experiment's workload. Scope boundary (explicit): cube maps and compressed formats remain out of scope and are not silently assumed complete.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024); sample_facet_vulkan_source() exists as a GLSL combined-image-sampler analogue but is deliberately not wired into vulkan_device_hal.cpp in this milestone (no Vulkan hardware reachable on this host)
